title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
description: Flamingo interleaves visual and text tokens in a pretrained frozen language model using Perceiver Resampler (to compress variable-resolution images into fixed-size embeddings) and cross-attention layers inserted between transformer blocks. Enables few-shot visual QA from just a few examples — no gradient updates at test time. First large-scale few-shot multimodal model.
authors: Alayrac, Donahue, Luc, Miech, Barr, Hasson, Lenc, Mensch, Millican, Reynolds, Ring, et al. (DeepMind)
